rev6.release_notes: Setup Sheet: right-click in the editor - stock, operations in order and every tool with its type and size (from your keywords); Copy, Print, Save PDF. Shared simulations draw each tool as Simulate does (boring bars included) and carry the G-SEND.IO logo. G-SEND.IO can now open a program straight into Simulate (for CAD CAM's SIMULATE button, coming in its next update).

cadcam.release_notes: SIMULATE in the Post window opens the program in G-SEND.IO's Simulate (with G-SEND.IO 6.0.563 or newer). Enter is OK in toolpath and setup windows. The Teach window's details are folded at the bottom. Shared simulations draw each tool as Simulate does, with the G-SEND.IO logo. Tools called DOVETAIL read as grooves.
